sources.title: 國圖《人鑑》1924北京復報社藏本（NLC416-17jh001751-107289；159图页）
sources.provider: National Library of China physical-book metadata via public Wikimedia Commons scan
sources.quality_notes: National Library of China digitization metadata identifies 1924 北京復報社发行, item 17jh001751/107289 and holding MG/293.1/517; PDF has 159 image pages versus 150 bibliographic pages. Browser original-PDF p0,p1,p2,p3-p9,p125-p132 and other samples visually inspected, showing dated 1924-08-10 author preface, upper volume names/cases and lower volume 命理擷要/五行旺弱/十干變化/取用 plus calendar/example entries. Local source PDF bytes and page SHA256 were NOT acquired; no formal physical-glyph SHA authority or whole-volume positive/negative collation. Catalog publication year not an independently verified impression day.

sources.title: 心一堂2018《命學苑苑刊—新命》第一集复刻说明及1927社团书目线索
sources.provider: Heart & Yi Tang publisher listing via Showwe distribution
sources.quality_notes: 2018-11 publisher issue ISBN9789888582105 claims restoration of 1927 Shanghai 命學宛 first edition, provides chapter list including founding declaration, articles by 林庚白/張一蟠 and others. Title spells 命學苑 and prose 命學宛: original 1927 spelling, proof of first impression and organizational records unverified. Multiple retail copies of publisher blurb are NOT independent witnesses; modern first/only/science rhetoric not original 1927 source-glyph evidence.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 1924北京《人鑑》與1927上海命學苑《新命》社团传承未由两书原页建立；仅2018说明报告人员重合
1927《新命》现代目录标题苑/正文宛不能自动统一为1927组织原字
1924、1927、1934现代时段并列不证明共同机构、直接抄传或验证预测有效性
